name: motion-moworks-card-flip
title: Card Flip
description: Thẻ lật quanh trục dọc 180° để lộ mặt sau, phồng nhẹ giữa chừng; mặt quay đi được ẩn nên không bao giờ thấy chữ bị lật ngược, rồi lật về.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Card 110x70 r8 with front (accent, 'FRONT', chip, number) and back (dark, stripe, 'BACK', 'DETAILS') faces. rotationY 0 → 180° over 0.7 s power2.inOut (0.4-1.1 s), back over 1.75-2.45 s after a hold; scaleY 1 + 0.06 × sin(angle) mid-flip; the face turned away is hidden (backface hidden, no mirrored text). AE: a 3D layer with two faces. (The demo also shows a wrong mirrored copy for comparison.) Params: duration (0.7 s, power2.inOut) · hold (0.65 s) · bulge (6 %) · faces: trước / sau. The face turned away is hidden, so the text is never seen mirrored.
